axes.model_access: Models are routed by Microsoft; official narratives mention OpenAI-family models plus Microsoft’s own MAI family, without a model-by-model list of current tiers. Whether a selector exists and what it offers follows the logged-in UI. Routing can change, so a single UI snapshot is not a commitment (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web (copilot.microsoft.com), Windows integration, iOS/Android apps and Edge integration; generation runs in Microsoft’s cloud. Microsoft 365 Copilot is a neighbouring but distinct product surface — this entry covers the consumer Copilot (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Chat history sits on the Microsoft account. The official privacy FAQ says conversations are saved by default, viewable in the Copilot app’s history, stored for 18 months by default and deletable individually or wholesale. Copilot for Windows references local recent items but does not scan or upload files automatically; browsing history stays on the device and is sent only according to settings (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Chat responses return immediately, and the official privacy FAQ lists no pause/resume task queue. Consumer Deep Research retired on 2026-08-18, with deep research moving to the Researcher agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot (official support page, 2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Web retrieval on the Bing base, image generation on the Designer/DALL·E line and image understanding are built in; deep research has retired on the consumer side, while the Researcher agent provides multi-step research in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Microsoft 365 app integration is another surface; official pages do not list MCP as a consumer capability (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Chat history syncs on login and is stored for 18 months by default. The official privacy FAQ and personalisation page say Copilot Memory infers preferences from prior conversations and uses them later; turning personalisation off stops memory and personalisation but does not delete history. Copilot Memory has a separate saved-memories management entry (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Microsoft accounts span personal and enterprise lines. The official privacy FAQ says that, except for opted-out users, Microsoft uses Copilot conversations, uploaded images/files and voice activity to train AI, removing names, account identifiers and other identifying data first. Personalisation switches sit in Copilot settings, with paths checked on the account page (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: Windows/Edge/Bing ecosystem users, free web-grounded Q&A and enterprises already in Microsoft’s ecosystem. Not fit: model choice, leaving the Microsoft account or direct mainland access (see the cn block) (2026-11-21).
